text: This report recommends that the name "Saul Korman Lane" be approved to identify a public lane south of Danforth Avenue, extending easterly from Carlaw Avenue then southerly to Harcourt Avenue. Community Councils have delegated authority to decide street naming matters which comply with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Saul Korman Lane" for a public lane south of Danforth Avenue, extending easterly from Carlaw Avenue then southerly to Harcourt Avenue.
